post_ship_review.summary: 10 findings verified (9 CONFIRMED + 1 NEEDS_NUANCE, 0 REFUTED) and precisely applied to the source MD (both zh and en editions).
fixes: §3.3 SD3: RF equation's data/noise identity was backward and the 'opposite of DDPM' claim was wrong — SD3's t=0/data, t=1/noise convention runs in the SAME direction as DDPM, not opposite (CONFIRMED; also fixed the duplicate restatement in §13 Q15)

§3.4 FLUX.1 spec table: 'text tokens use absolute position encoding' corrected — FLUX text-token RoPE ids (txt_ids) are set to all zeros (no explicit positional encoding); ordering comes from T5's own relative-position mechanism (CONFIRMED)

§6.7 InstantID row: 'face embedding decoupled from ID embedding' was mischaracterized — InstantID injects the face embedding itself (ArcFace/insightface) as the identity embedding via decoupled cross-attention + IdentityNet (landmark ControlNet) (CONFIRMED)
§6.7 PhotoMaker row: mechanism was backward — PhotoMaker's 'Stacked ID Embedding' stacks per-photo ID embeddings (each fused with the class word first), not average-then-concat (CONFIRMED)
§7.7 Custom Diffusion: corrected from 'essentially a narrower LoRA-DreamBooth' to an independent selective full-parameter (non-low-rank) fine-tuning method (CONFIRMED)

§9.2 ADD: removed a fabricated third 'score loss' — ADD's total loss has only two terms (adversarial + a single score-distillation-style distillation loss); the tutorial had double-counted the distillation term as two (CONFIRMED; also fixed the duplicate '三件套/three-in-one' restatement in §13 Q19)

§13 Q4: SD/SDXL U-Net middle block was wrongly said to have 'no cross-attn' — it is a standard SpatialTransformer/UNetMidBlock2DCrossAttn with self-attn + cross-attn + FFN, consistent with §3.1's own correct description (CONFIRMED; this was an internal self-contradiction)

§0/§2.2/§13 Q1: 'f=8 downsample -> exactly 64x compute savings' softened to an order-of-magnitude estimate — latent channel width and the quadratic scaling of self-attention FLOPs with token count mean actual savings deviate from a precise 64x (NEEDS_NUANCE)
§13 Q7: LoRA parameter ratio formula corrected from the approximation r/min(d,k) to the exact r(d+k)/dk = r(1/d+1/k), which equals 2r/n (not r/n) in the common square-matrix case d=k=n (CONFIRMED)
§3.2/§13 Q11: SDXL size/crop conditioning corrected from 4 scalars to 6 — target_size (h_tgt, w_tgt) for multi-aspect-ratio training was missing alongside original_size and crop_top_left (CONFIRMED)
